URL
Service TypeJSON
Operation idReassignapproval
Oracle View/SP Name    APPS.XXHMC_SND_REASSIGN_PR
INPUT(p_username,                                 p_type>,                                                        p_notification_id,                                 p_dusername,                                p_comment,                                 p_success_flag,                                 p_error_msg,                                 p_error_msg_ar);                                 commit;
Query
DECLARE
    p_success_flag   VARCHAR2 (2500);
    p_error_msg      VARCHAR2 (2500);
    p_error_msg_ar   VARCHAR2 (2500);
BEGIN
    APPS.XXHMC_SND_REASSIGN_PR ('V-ISIDDIQUI',
                                'DELEGATE',                         --TRANSFER
                                123846878,
                                'V-NFERNANDO',
                                'Test Delegate From Inzamam,
                                p_success_flag,
                                p_error_msg,
                                p_error_msg_ar);
                                commit;
END;
